newsitem.title: UK: Euromoney to buy Institutional Investor for $141 million.
newsitem.headline: Euromoney to buy Institutional Investor for $141 million.

text.p: Euromoney Publications Plc said Wednesday it agreed to buy rival financial publisher Institutional Investor Inc. for 84 million pounds ($141 million) in cash.
"We think it will be a very good fit," Euromoney Chairman Padriac Fallon said in an interview, Reuters, adding Institutional Investor had "a wonderful brand name."

Institutional Investor, which publishes two editions of the magazine of the same name and has 23 newsletters and a conference division, had been on the market for some time. It is being sold by ABC Inc., a unit of Walt Disney Co.

"II has got a jewel of a newsletter business," Fallon said. "We prize that. It is a base to create an international business from." Euromoney publishes the magazine of that name and a wide variety of financial and business publications.

Euromoney has not set plans for the Institutional Investor products, but there was limited overlap, Fallon said. Only the Institutional Investory international edition overlaps with Euromoney in terms of advertising. Institutional InvestorI's international edition has a circulation of 45,000, compared with U.S. circulation of 100,000. Euromoney has about 32,000 subscribers.

Regarding management and staffing, Fallon said Institutional InvestorI's decision-making would be kept in New York. He added that he wanted "good stable U.S. management" for the group's expanded U.S. operation rather than British managers parachuting in.
He also ruled out merging or closing the international edition of Institutional Investor. "The least likely outcome would be to shut it down."

Euromoney's confidence in the potential for the combination is underlined by the fact it is taking out a $150 million loan, the first time it has done so, to pay for the purchase. The loan is from HSBC Group.
Euromoney's largest shareholder, Associated Newspapers, with 72.5 percent of its equity, said it supports the move, which is subject to a vote at a special shareholder meeting.
Euromoney earned record profits of 12 million pounds ($20 million) for the six months through March. Institutional Investor reported operating profits of about $74 million last year, Euromoney said.
